headline: Public hearing on paving a parking lot at 206 Calvary Street, plus a deck rebuild at 3 Copeland Street.
summary: The applicant asked to move the Calvary Street hearing to the 12/3 meeting. Other items cover a deck and roof project on Copeland Street and a sidewalk at 400 Beaver Street.
items: Public hearing on Notice of Intent for paving and striping the parking lot at 180, 206-R12, 206 Calvary Street, plus stormwater upgrades (continued from 11/5/2026; applicant requested continuance to 12/3)
Request for Determination of Applicability for reconstructing a deck and replacing roof shingles at 3 Copeland Street
Request for Certificate of Compliance for a sidewalk and electrical and telecommunication conduits at 400 Beaver Street, Bentley University
Correspondence: DCR's invasive plant management work in Beaver Brook Reservation ended 11/10

Waltham Conservation Commission 
November 19, 2026 
7:00 p.m. 
Meeting Agenda 
 
Pursuant to the relevant legislation, including Mass. Acts 2025 c.2, this meeting will take place 
remotely. All Open Meeting Law requirements will be met and public access will be available by Zoom 
call. Residents who need a device to connect are invited to use a public desktop or borrow a 
laptop at the Waltham public library (valid library card required). 
For this meeting, members of the public may participate by joining at: 
https://us02web.zoom.us/j/86478567649?pwd=NZzNgDrmAQNIISNS6jXN701jTdi71b.1   
Passcode: Waltham 
We will post a link to the video recording at http://www.wcac.org/government/meetings/conservation-
commission as soon as possible after the meeting. 
 
Public Hearing 
Notice of Intent (DEP File # 316-0856) (Continued from 11/5/2026) 
Applicant: Audrey Hunt / NSTAR Energy Co. d/b/a Eversource Energy 
Property Location: 180, 206-R12, 206 Calvary Street 
Project Description: Paving and striping of an existing parking lot, stormwater management 
infrastructure upgrades, and associated ancillary work. 
Applicant has requested a continuance to the 12/3 meeting. 
 
 
Public Meeting 
Request for Determination of Applicability 
Applicant: Kenneth W. Sumner 
Property Location: 3 Copeland Street 
Project Description: Reconstruct the existing deck within the existing footprint and replace roof 
shingles. A portion of the house lies within the Buffer Zone. There will be no construction closer to the 
wetlands and no increase to impervious area. 
 
 
 
Public Meeting 
Request for Certificate of Compliance (DEP File # 316-0848) 
Applicant: Jon Nattinville / Bentley University 
Property Location: 400 Beaver Street 
Project Description: Construct sidewalk adjacent to existing Linden Street access, including 
electrical and telecommunication conduits. 
 
Commission Business 
• Approval of meeting minutes from 11-05-2026.
Correspondence 
• INFORMATIONAL: DCR notified that the last day of their invasive management work in Beaver 
Brook Reservation was 11/10. Primarily glossy buckthorn.
